description: Call before your agent approves, receives or sends a Base ERC-20. Returns code size, EIP-7702 delegation, name, symbol, decimals, supply, proxy and upgrade admin, owner or renounced, and which privileged functions the bytecode has (mint, pause, blocklist, fees, limits, trading switch, upgrade). Facts only: no grades, not investment advice. If Base can't be read, nothing is charged. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid over x402 (MCP transport): an unpaid call returns a PaymentRequired result, and an x402 MCP client retries with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]. You sign one USDC authorisation for exactly that price to Wren's wallet: no approvals. Bad input is rejected before anything is charged.
